title: GTNH CubicChunks patch bundle
notes: Install on the normal RC2 base pack. This ZIP does not update beta3 configs, quests or launcher libraries.
Contains every completed compatibility patch in the maintained inventory, including partial compatibility fixes.
Prior per-patch builds, reviews and harness checks have different scopes; this is not a claim of complete compatibility for every feature.
Storage writes default to Zstandard and new worlds use compact empty-cube storage. Older unpatched CC cannot read all of these records.
The world-converter UI is not included.

RC2 carries 88 mod version updates from beta3; 38 patch jars were rebuilt. Angelica remains the newer patched 2.2.29; Hydro already matches 1.4.25. Historical compatibility notes below retain their original evidence scope.
